column2: interval: minutes between bands (normal, min, max; growth: how much a fast-rising prestige shortens it; jitter: random share). protection: hours after the capital and prestige before any band. lead: minutes from a band appearing to its arrival by scouting level (0, 1, 2, 3...). prestige: factors on resources lost / bandits slain. level: ranks per band level, random spread. size: how many come = base + perPrestige x prestige^exponent, give or take jitter; laneJitter / mixJitter: how unevenly they split over lanes and tiers. drops: chance of a first and a second drop.
column3: 流寇：interval 出现间隔（分钟：normalMinutes 普通、growth 声望增速缩短的力度、jitter 随机幅度、minMinutes / maxMinutes 上下限）；protection 新手保护（建都后 hours 小时内、声望低于 prestige 时不来）；lead 按斥候等级的到达时间（分钟，0、1、2、3… 级，min / max 上下限）；prestige 声望折算（perResource 每资源声望、lossFactor 被抢与阵亡的折算、winFactor 击杀流寇的折算）；level 流寇等级（ranksPerLevel 每几级官职升一级、spread 随机浮动）；size 流寇人数（base 基数 + perPrestige × 当前声望^exponent，jitter 总数随机幅度、laneJitter 各路分配、mixJitter 各等级比例的随机幅度）；drops 击败后第一、第二件掉落的概率。
